Read : Rules 162 to 169A of Chapter XV of Gujarat High Court
Rules, 1993, regarding Destruction of Records.
NOTICE
All concerned parties/Learned Advocates are hereby informed that parties
leave documents and papers with the records of the following cases at their own
risk and that such documents and papers are liable to be destructed in accordance
with the Rules for the Destruction of Records under Chapter XV of the Gujarat High
Court Rules, 1993.
Therefore, all concerned parties/learned advocates are hereby given notice
that if they are desirous to get Certified Copy/Simple Copy or Original papers,
which are not required to be preserved i.e. (1) All Bail applications (i.e., Regular
Bail, Anticipatory Bail, Temporary Bail, Transit Bail, Default Bail, Parole, Furlough,
Cancellation of Bail, Successive Regular Bail-Before Charge Sheet and After Charge
Sheet, Successive Anticipatory Bail, not filed in Criminal Appeals) disposed of
during the period from 01.01.2022 to 31.12.2023 alongwith their Interlocutory
Applications disposed upto 2024; and (2) All Criminal Appeals (CR.As) filed for bail
under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989, which were disposed of during the period from 01.01.2015 to 31.12.23 and
in which all connected matters/interlocutory applications were also disposed of
during the said period, as per attached list, they shall have to submit an
application physically in the prescribed format (specimen attached) in the Chamber
of Mr. Vinod Ramanlal Patel, Assistant Registrar/Court Master of Decree
Department during the period from 01.04.2026 to 15.04.2026 during office hours.
It is further notified that no applications for the supply of certified copies, simple
copies, or original papers in respect of the aforesaid disposed matters shall be
accepted or entertained after 15.04.2026.
The concerned learned Advocates/parties are hereby informed that they
shall collect the Certified Copies, Simple Copies, or original papers pertaining to
the said matters, which are not required to be preserved, on or before 20.04.2026,
failing which the papers shall be destructed.
Mr. Vinod Ramanlal Patel, Assistant Registrar/Court Master of Decree
Department shall verify all the pending applications for Certified Copy/Simple copy
and clear the same before the work of destruction of aforesaid matters is carried
out.
By Order of the Hon’ble Chief Justice
